newsitem.title: NORWAY: Operation improves at Statoil's Mongstad refinery.
newsitem.headline: Operation improves at Statoil's Mongstad refinery.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday the Mongstad oil refinery on the west coast of Norway had celebrated its first year of operation without a cracker shutdown.
Statoil said plant availabilty for the cracker at the eight million tonne per year refinery had been below expectations since it came onstream in 1989.
"Reasons have varied from mechanical failures to instrumentation errors and lightning bolts," the company's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Work began in 1993 to identify the causes of the unplanned shutdowns and later improvement proposals were drawn up.
"Statoil Mongstad's long-term goal is to run the plant for more than three years without planned or unplanned stoppages," Statoil said.
